# limitations under the License.
#
################################################################################
# build libpcap
tar -xvzf libpcap-1.9.1.tar.gz
cd libpcap-1.9.1
./configure --disable-shared
make -j"$(nproc)"
make install
cd ..
# build project
cd ndpi
sh autogen.sh
./configure --enable-fuzztargets
make
make -C fuzz fuzz_ndpi_reader_seed_corpus.zip
# copy fuzz executables to output directory
cp -v fuzz/fuzz_ndpi_reader "$OUT/"
cp -v fuzz/fuzz_process_packet "$OUT/"
--- configure hints ---
grep: ./.git/index: binary file matches
./configure.ac:19:AC_ARG_ENABLE(fuzztargets, AS_HELP_STRING([--enable-fuzztargets], [Enable fuzz targets]),[enable_fuzztargets=$enableval],[enable_fuzztargets=no])
./configure.ac:199:        [AC_MSG_ERROR([--enable-fuzztargets requires -fsanitize=fuzzer which is only supported by LLVM])],
./fuzz/Makefile.am:1:bin_PROGRAMS = fuzz_process_packet fuzz_process_packet_with_main fuzz_ndpi_reader fuzz_ndpi_reader_with_main
./fuzz/Makefile.am:3:fuzz_process_packet_SOURCES = fuzz_process_packet.c
./fuzz/Makefile.am:4:fuzz_process_packet_CFLAGS =
./fuzz/Makefile.am:5:fuzz_process_packet_LDADD = ../src/lib/libndpi.a
./fuzz/Makefile.am:6:fuzz_process_packet_LDFLAGS = $(ADDITIONAL_LIBS) $(LIBS)
./fuzz/Makefile.am:8:fuzz_process_packet_CFLAGS += $(LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE)
./fuzz/Makefile.am:9:fuzz_process_packet_LDFLAGS += $(LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE)
./fuzz/Makefile.am:12:fuzz_process_packet_LINK=$(LIBTOOL) $(AM_V_lt) --tag=CC $(AM_LIBTOOLFLAGS) \
./fuzz/Makefile.am:14:    $(fuzz_process_packet_LDFLAGS) $(LDFLAGS) -o $@
./fuzz/Makefile.am:16:fuzz_process_packet_with_main_SOURCES = fuzz_process_packet.c
./fuzz/Makefile.am:17:fuzz_process_packet_with_main_CFLAGS = -DBUILD_MAIN
./fuzz/Makefile.am:18:fuzz_process_packet_with_main_LDADD = ../src/lib/libndpi.a
./fuzz/Makefile.am:19:fuzz_process_packet_with_main_LDFLAGS = $(ADDITIONAL_LIBS) $(LIBS)
./fuzz/Makefile.am:21:fuzz_process_packet_with_main_LINK=$(LIBTOOL) $(AM_V_lt) --tag=CC $(AM_LIBTOOLFLAGS) \
./fuzz/Makefile.am:23:    $(fuzz_process_packet_with_main_LDFLAGS) $(LDFLAGS) -o $@
./fuzz/fuzz_process_packet.c:47:            (argc > 0 ? argv[0] : "fuzz_process_packet_with_main"));
./tests/ossfuzz.sh:27:./configure --enable-fuzztargets
./tests/ossfuzz.sh:32:cp -v fuzz/fuzz_process_packet "$OUT/"
